primary_source_scope.OWR: Theorem 5 gives 2d-1 for disjoint balls. The paragraph following it asks about further generalization and does not explicitly conjecture that same number for arbitrary convex sets.
primary_source_scope.Rote_attribution: The six-cylinder construction is credited to Guenter Rote. The printed closed cylinders have same-side tangencies; the box proof independently supplies strict separation and compactness. This is not a claim that the source asserted strict disjointness.
primary_source_scope.Aronov: The bound six applies to disjoint three-dimensional polytopes with no facet coplanar with the line. Arbitrarily large constructions allow intersections. The authors leave boundedness for pairwise disjoint convex polytopes as a conjecture.
